events.title: Abbey Road released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, Abbey Road, on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That iconic zebra crossing, those timeless tracks... what's your favourite moment from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! From 'Brass in Pocket' to 'Don't Get Me Wrong', her voice is unmistakable. What's your top Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Love him or loathe him, you can't deny his rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: Imagine released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates today with its powerful message of peace and unity. What does it mean to you?

events.title: Original iPod launched
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Tech Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember '1,000 songs in your pocket'? Twenty-five years ago, Apple launched the original iPod and changed how we listen to music forever. Did you have one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since Dr. No first hit screens, who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us countless laughs. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Double Album Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. Which track from the double album is your go-to?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost an irreplaceable talent. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Game-Changing Album
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul' – an album that pushed boundaries and influenced countless artists. What's your standout track?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world fell silent for John Lennon. His message of peace and love lives on through his incredible music. Share your favourite.
